name: Audie
houseDescription: Bright rattan and palm with vintage flair — vacation home that never quite left the seventies.
description: Named after a long-time fan and full of pep. Great for colorful, music-forward islands.

seo.title: Audie — Peppy wolf
seo.description: Named after a long-time fan and full of pep. Great for colorful, music-forward islands.

acnh.appearance: Audie glows fox-bright despite being a wolf — orange fur washed pale gold along her snout, hands, feet, and tail tip. White sunglasses with purple lenses rest on her forehead like a permanent vacation mood. Teal lines the inside of her ears; blonde hair sweeps to one side. Her blue eyes carry long lashes and a sweep of yellow shadow, and her catchphrase nods to the foxlike silhouette she wears so easily.
acnh.personality: Audie radiates peppy sunshine — quick compliments, little gifts, and a smile that fills the plaza. Her attention jumps fast; she can overreact to small slights, and snooty or cranky villagers sometimes read her enthusiasm as rude. Lazy neighbors can feel like a mismatch, while jocks get her cheer in return — she treats their energy like a dance partner. Normal, big sister, and smug villagers round out her circle with ease. Befriending her is straightforward: show up, match her warmth, and she settles into the villagers she trusts most. She forgives fast, forgets arguments quickly, and keeps the island feeling like a party that never quite ends.

villagerInfo.quote: Be the kind of person your future self won't regret having been.
